product_metadata.title: Corelle Coordinates by Reston Lloyd Bamboo Leaf Acrylic Rock Glasses, 14-Ounce, Set of 6
features: Set includes six, 14-Ounce acrylic rocks glasses for indoor or outdoor use
Made from high grade acrylic/plastic to provide glass like quality and clarity and greater durability
Features a lightweight glass with Corelle Coordinates Bamboo Leaf pattern
BPA free; use for cold beverages only; dishwasher safe
Coordinates to match Corelle Coordinates dinnerware and accessories
description: Reston Lloyd produces high quality enamel on steel kitchen, melamine, and acrylic accessories to produce Corelle Coordinates as well as their private brand Calypso Basics. In addition, Reston Lloyd is the exclusive distributor for both Romertopf and MAWA which are home & kitchen products from Germany. These high end quality products are one of the cornerstones to Reston Lloyd, who focuses on quality merchandise from Germany. For nearly 30 years, we have been dedicated to providing the highest quality products, with an equal emphasis on superior customer service. This Corelle Coordinate Glass Set is made of durable, BPA free plastic/acrylic. This lightweight rocks glass holds 14 ounces, measures 3.25" by 4" and is dishwasher safe.
